name: Navezuelas (Spain)
description: Green field with a white lozenge throughout, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Navezuelas (a chestnut tree on green).
history: The arms and the flag of Navezuelas were approved by the Order of 28 May 1992, published in the Diario Oficial de Extremadura no. 44 of 4 June 1992, after the administrative file prepared by the council on 29 and 30 April 1992; the arms are vert, a lozenge argent charged with a chestnut tree.

features.role: Navezuelas arms — chestnut tree on green
